{{Top}}
'''Electronic countermeasures''', otherwise known as '''ECM''', was an electronic system designed to fool [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] into reading wrong or no information. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] utilized this system during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. It was also used during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] by [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]].
